name: agentica-lsp
description: Diagnostics, hover, completion, go to definition, references and symbols for Agentica (.agc) files from the agc-lsp language server.

agentica.server.path.description: Command or path for a custom language server. Leave empty to use the bundled launcher.

agentica.server.agenticaPath.description: Absolute path to the Agentica executable. Leave empty to use AGENTICA, PATH, or ~/.local/bin on macOS.

agentica.server.logLevel.description: Level of the server log shown in the Agentica output channel (stderr of the server).

agentica.server.clientLogLevel.description: Level of the log messages the server sends to the editor.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check stage-server.js && node --check test/vsix.js && node --check test/diagnostics.js
